topography.project_purpose: Onchain Capital Allocator. Structurally: 89 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 3 ERC4626 vaults, 7 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 5 functional families. Its contracts share 23 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, accesscontrolupgradeable, contextupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
